note: Catalogue of NVGate notifications, extracted from the Notification Mechanism reference manual. A notification is what NVGate sends you when the operator changes something: register for it with RegisterState / RegisterSetting / RegisterUINotification, then decode the block you receive. `command_id` identifies the notification in that block; `properties` describes the fields that follow, in order. Note that pynvdrive provides no Python wrapper for this family; the `orostk.nvdrive` package does, and your own process must run a TCP server that NVGate connects back to (see the HOWTO). Property fields: `type` is the data type prefixed by its numeric code, `name_id` the property identifier prefixed by its number, `value` either an example placeholder or the accepted values, `unit`, `hidden` and `const` the flags the manual prints. **`_alignment` is a warning, not data**: it marks a row whose columns could not be aligned with certainty because the source table merges cells irregularly. Treat those rows as indicative and check them against the manual mirror before relying on them. `enumtype` appears on enumerated properties and says **which list of values applies**; on its own it is just a number. Resolve it in `reference_tables.enumerated_property_types` - `enumtype` 18 is "Applied mode". Resolve the number in front of `type` in `reference_tables.property_types`, and the number in front of `name_id` in `reference_tables.property_identifiers`, where `used_in` says which commands that identifier belongs to (identifier 500 means "Window caption" in a Message Box, and nowhere else). `property_count` is what the manual declares; it disagrees with the rows actually printed on a handful of notifications, and is occasionally a range rather than a number. Trust the length of `properties`. The remaining fields are self-describing: `name` and `section` locate the notification in the manual, `manual_page` gives the page, `semantics` is what it means, `how_to_trigger` the command that turns it on, and `comment` any caveat the manual adds.

notifications.name: CHANGE USER
notifications.semantics: Scan when the User is being changed.
notifications.how_to_trigger: This command can be sent from the "Home/User" ribbon or "Preferences/User" ribbon.

notifications.name: APPLIED MODE
notifications.semantics: Scan when the "applied mode" is being changed.
notifications.how_to_trigger: This command can be sent with the activation or desactivation of the specialized modes: Rotating or Structural, in "Preferences/General" window.

notifications.name: POST ANALYSIS
notifications.semantics: Scan when the analyzer is being switched to/from the post-analysis mode.
notifications.how_to_trigger: This command can be sent from the "Home/Go to result" ribbon.

notifications.name: SET UNIT TO MAGNITUDE
notifications.semantics: Scan when the physical quantity is being modified.
notifications.how_to_trigger: Use the "SetUnit" NVDrive command.

notifications.name: TOGGLE DOCKABLE WINDOW
notifications.semantics: Scan when one of the "View" elements is being displayed or hidden.
notifications.how_to_trigger: Click on one of the check boxes from the "Preferences/View" ribbon.

properties.value: 33309: Analyzer Status 34047: Workspace 34048: Log Window 34057: Setting Grid

notifications.name: TOGGLE MODULE STATE
notifications.semantics: Scan when the plug-in states are being displayed or hidden.
notifications.how_to_trigger: Right-click on an active analysis plug-in and select/unselect the "View States" item.

notifications.name: WINDOW REFRESH RATE
notifications.semantics: Scan when the user Refresh Rate preference is being modified.
notifications.how_to_trigger: Open the dialog box with the "Preference/General" ribbon. Move the "Windows refresh rate" cursor to modify its value:

notifications.name: NEW MEASUREMENT PREFERENCE PARAMETER
notifications.semantics: Scan when a measurement preference to save measurement is being changed.
notifications.how_to_trigger: Click on the "General" button from the "Preferences / Preferences" ribbon to open the "Preferences" dialog box. Change one of the save options from the "Save" tab:

properties.value: 0: Do not save 1: In Default Measurement 2: With name confirmation 3: Without name confirmation

notifications.name: CONNECT INPUT
notifications.semantics: Scan when an input or a track is being connected to a module.
notifications.how_to_trigger: Use "ConnectInput" NVDrive command. Either, this command can be sent when connecting inputs or tracks (in the post-analysis mode) to an analysis module. Select "Show Results" from the "Home / Go to result" ribbon.

notifications.name: SELECT WATERFALL CHANNELS
notifications.semantics: Scan when a channel is being connected to the waterfall module.

notifications.name: UNSELECT WATERFALL CHANNELS
notifications.semantics: Scan when a channel is being disconnected from the waterfall module.
notifications.how_to_trigger: To disconnect waterfall channels: Open the dialog box with the "Analysis / Waterfall" ribbon. Or, open this dialog box from the Analyzer Setting Browser by a right-click on "Waterfall→ Channels" and select the item "Add/Remove". Select items to be removed from the "Waterfall" or "References & Profiles" frames and click on the red-cross button.

notifications.name: EXEC COMMAND
notifications.semantics: Scan when an analysis command is being executed.
notifications.how_to_trigger: This command can be sent with the [Run / Pause / Stop / Trigger / Pause Player] and [Accept / Reject] buttons.

properties.value: 0 Run 1 Pause 2 Stop 3 Accept 4 Reject 5 Manual Trigger 6 Pause Player

notifications.name: CHANGE ACTION SETTING
notifications.semantics: Scan when an action is performed (hidden).

notifications.name: CHANGE ARMING ACTION SETTING
notifications.semantics: Scan when the [Recorder Arming] button state is being changed.
notifications.how_to_trigger: At least one input must be connected to a recorder track to activate the recorder module. Click on the Armed/Unarmed button from the "Analysis / Record" ribbon. Or from the Analyzer Setting Browser, select the "Recorder → Trigger → Recorder" setting and click on the button to change it to [Arm] or [Unarm].

notifications.name: CHANGE AUTORANGE ACTION SETTING
notifications.semantics: Scan when the [Autorange] action is being executed.
notifications.how_to_trigger: Click on the [Autorange] button from the "Acquisition / Inputs" ribbon. Or from the Analyzer Setting Browser, select the "Front-End → Auto-ranging → Autorange" setting and click on the [Run] button to start the Autorange.

notifications.name: CHANGE ICP ACTION SETTING
notifications.semantics: Scan when the ICP checking is being executed.
notifications.how_to_trigger: At least one input must be of the ICP coupling type. From the Analyzer Setting Browser, select the "Front-End → Input Settings → Check ICP" setting and click on the [Run] button to start the ICP checking.

notifications.name: CHANGE TEDS ACTION SETTING
notifications.semantics: Scan when the ICP checking is being executed.
notifications.how_to_trigger: At least one input must be of the ICP TEDS coupling type. From the Analyzer Setting Browser, select the "Front-End → Input Settings → Detect TEDS" setting and click on the [Run] button to start the TEDS checking. Or click on the "detect TEDS" button from the "Acquisition / Transducers" ribbon.

notifications.name: ACTIVATE SUB-MODULE COLLECTION
notifications.semantics: Scan when an item from a sub-module collection is being activated/desabled.
notifications.how_to_trigger: From the Analyzer Setting Browser, select a sub-module setting and right-click the "Add/Remove" item to open a dialog box. The sub-module collection is recognizable by an icon. Example: Select the "FFT 1→ Channels" collection and open the Add/Remove dialog box. Then select channel3.

notifications.name: CHANGE SETTING
notifications.semantics: Scan when a setting is modified. Not used (hidden).

notifications.name: CHANGE STRING SETTING
notifications.semantics: Scan when the value of a string setting is being changed.
notifications.how_to_trigger: From the Analyzer Setting Browser, select a string setting and assign a new string value. The string setting is recognizable by an icon. Example: Select the "Front-End → Inputs → Input 1 → Label" setting and write another label.

notifications.name: CHANGE BOOLEAN SETTING
notifications.semantics: Scan when the value of a boolean setting is being changed.
notifications.how_to_trigger: From the Analyzer Setting Browser, select a boolean setting and switch it. The boolean setting is recognizable by an icon. Example: Select the "Front-End → Inputs → Input 1 → Enable auto-range" setting and tick/untick the box.

notifications.name: CHANGE SCALAR SETTING
notifications.semantics: Scan when the value of a scalar setting is being changed.
notifications.how_to_trigger: From the Analyzer Setting Browser, select a scalar setting and modify its value. The scalar setting is recognizable by an icon. Example: Select the "Front-End → Input Settings → Sensitivity" setting assign a new scalar value.

notifications.name: CHANGE ENUMERATED SETTING
notifications.semantics: Scan when the value of an enumerated setting is being changed.
notifications.how_to_trigger: From the Analyzer Setting Browser, select an enumerated setting and select an item from the list. The enumerated setting is recognizable by an icon. Example: Select the "Front-End → Input Settings → High Input sampling" setting and select an item from the list.

notifications.name: CHANGE FORCE/RESPONSE WINDOWS SETTING
notifications.semantics: Scan when one of the values of the Force or Response window setting is being changed.
notifications.how_to_trigger: From the Analyzer Setting Browser, select the "Time Windows → Force → Settings" or the "Time Windows → Response → Settings" and change one of the window settings. The force/response window setting is recognizable by an icon.

notifications.name: CHANGE FRACTIONAL TACH SETTING
notifications.semantics: Scan when one of the values of the fractional tach ratio setting is being changed.
notifications.how_to_trigger: It is activated with a NVDrive command: "SetVirtualTachoSettingValue".

notifications.name: CHANGE SIGNAL FILE SETTING
notifications.semantics: Scan when the signal file loaded in the Player module is being changed.
notifications.how_to_trigger: From the Analyzer Setting Browser, select the "Player → Selected Record → Signal File" setting select a signal file from a project. The signal file setting is recognizable by an icon.

notifications.name: CHANGE MATRIX SETTING
notifications.semantics: Scan when the value of a matrix setting is being changed.
notifications.how_to_trigger: From the Analyzer Setting Browser, select a matrix setting and add/remove an item. The matrix setting is recognizable by an icon. Example: When 2 inputs are connected to the FFT1 module, select the "FFT1→ FFT analysis → Cross Spectrum" setting and add a matrix cross between channel 2 and channel 1.

notifications.name: CHANGE TABLE SETTING
notifications.semantics: Scan when one of the values of a line in a table setting is being changed.
notifications.how_to_trigger: Use a NVDrive command: AddArrayLine (and NB Properties = 5). You can either select a Table setting and add a new line from the Analyzer Setting Browser (then NB Properties = 1). The table setting is recognizable by an icon. Example: Select the "FFT 1 → Channels→ Channel 1→ Tracked Order" setting and Click on the [Add] button.

notifications.name: REMOVE LINE IN A TABLE SETTING
notifications.semantics: Scan when a line is being removed from a table setting.
notifications.how_to_trigger: From the Analyzer Setting Browser, select a Table setting and remove one of its lines. Example: Select the "FFT 1 → Channels→ Channel 1→ Tracked Order" setting, select an exiting item (or click on [Add] to add a line) and click on the [Remove] button.

notifications.name: FULL SCREEN
notifications.semantics: Scan when the Full Screen display mode is being switched.
notifications.how_to_trigger: Click on the "Full Screen" button in the "Dispplay / Arrangement" ribbon to switch the Full Screen mode.

notifications.how_to_trigger: Select the "Analyzer Setting Brower / Control Panel / Project Manager" tab from the Workspace.
